info.title: OctaP Core API
info.description:
REST API of octap-core. Three kinds of caller:

- **Merchant backend**: `Authorization: Bearer <api key>`. Send `X-Organization-Id` to have the
  key checked against the organization you expect. Some routes also need a signed request.
- **Console user**: `Authorization: Bearer <Google ID token>` from the console sign-in.
- **Customer device**: public routes with no credential, rate limited per client IP.

Each operation lists its auth, required scopes and limits in its description and in the
`x-octap-auth` extension. Errors use the shared `ErrorResponse` shape.

apiKey.description: Merchant API key, issued per organization.

consoleSession.description: Google ID token of a signed-in console user.

signedTimestamp.name: X-OctaP-Timestamp
signedTimestamp.description: Unix seconds; must be within the replay window.

signedNonce.name: X-OctaP-Nonce
signedNonce.description: Unique per request; reuse is rejected.

signedSignature.name: X-OctaP-Signature
signedSignature.description: HMAC of the request, keyed by the API key. See the SDK for the exact canonical string.

OrganizationIdHeader.name: X-Organization-Id
OrganizationIdHeader.description: Optional. When sent, the request is rejected (403) unless the API key belongs to this organization.
